Each clip: native source pixels — 480×480 (34 clips) or 360×360 (1 clip), 8 real frames at the source's native frame rate (25 / 29.97 / 30 fps), H.264 CRF16. The motion-4 system abstained on all of these (AMBIG = zoom/expansion, rotation, cuts, multi-motion, complex deformation, or uncertainty). No metric substitutes for your judgment.
